body.x: Rollkers SAS (www.rollkers.com), an innovative company specializing in personal transit accessories from France, unveiled Rollkers at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Rollkers presents a totally new way of personal transit with its invention. Users simply affix Rollkers to the bottom of their shoes and gain the immediate ability to reach speeds up to seven miles per hour simply by walking or strolling normally. It can be an alternative choice to public transportation that is free from overcrowding and vehicular emissions.
